description: To develop the ability to research a recent topic in AI/ML independently and present it clearly to an academic audience.

syllabus.title: Seminar
syllabus.body: Each student identifies a recent topic/technology in Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning, prepares a technical report, and delivers a seminar presentation followed by a question-answer session.

outcomes: Independently research and present a technical topic.
Improve written and oral technical communication skills.
